mechanics.definition: 按预先定义的线路坐标、方向、连续轴条件和赔付表逐条确认中奖结果。
evidence_signatures: settlement records identify paid line ids and winning symbols
exclusions: wins are counted from arbitrary adjacent reel combinations without line ids
wins depend only on all-board symbol count or connected clusters

mechanics.definition: 从规定起始侧沿相邻轴匹配同一结算符号，按各轴实际参与符号数的组合数量派奖，不依赖固定线路编号。

conditional_packages.when: 与board.variable-grid同时存在；该包只承接由实际布局变化产生的容量语义
同时命中settlement.effective-ways-capacity；该包承接固定布局非几何变化，或可变布局叠加非几何规则后的最终实际Ways容量

evidence_signatures: settlement records expose actual winning ways or per-reel contributing symbol counts
no fixed payline id is required to reproduce the payout
variable_ways is explicitly true or false and available_ways_formula deterministically reproduces the per-board opportunity capacity, including a constant formula when capacity is fixed
exclusions: all-board count pay without adjacent-reel matching

mechanics.definition: 在Ways结算中，因Split Symbol、符号多重计数、超大符号或其他非几何规则，使最终实际可用Ways容量不能只由盘面几何布局唯一推出；固定布局和可变布局叠加非几何规则均可使用。容量表示结算机会规模，不等于某次中奖实际命中的Ways数。
evidence_signatures: geometry_layout_binding identifies the exact fixed or variable layout used by every capacity observation
the effective Ways capacity takes more than one actual value after conditioning on the declared geometry context or across the sealed scope
protocol, board facts, non-layout rule inputs and the sealed formula reproduce each board's final actual capacity before return comparison
exclusions: capacity varies only because reel heights or valid-cell layout change and no non-layout rule contributes; use board.variable-grid
actual capacity is constant in the sealed scope
only the paid winning Ways count varies while available capacity is fixed

mechanics.definition: 在密封统计范围内按某一合格符号的实际数量查表派奖，不要求固定线路、相邻轴组合或连通关系。
evidence_signatures: payout is reproducible from eligible symbol id and actual count inside the declared scope
settlement output records the paid count
exclusions: symbols must be adjacent as one connected component
payout is the sum of dynamic values attached to symbol instances
a symbol count only triggers a feature but pays no direct award

mechanics.definition: 按明确邻接规则识别同符号连通块，每个达到门槛的独立连通块作为一个结算结果派奖。
evidence_signatures: winning coordinates form reproducible connected components under the declared adjacency rule
settlement records expose actual paid cluster size or member coordinates
near_miss_structure_relevant is explicitly investigated and sealed as true or false from source evidence
exclusions: all matching symbols are counted regardless of adjacency
wins require fixed line ids or adjacent reel ways
visual groups that are not independent paid components
